brief: A shift supervisor's resolution log documenting a drive-thru order mix-up, allergen alert, and subsequent customer remediation.

slip.document:
# Guest Incident and Order Resolution Log
Store #4108 - Oakridge Crossing
Shift: Morning / Lunch Transition (11:00 - 15:00)
Date: 04/18/2026

## Incident Details
- Time of Occurrence: 12:42 PM
- Order Number: #318
- Register Station: Drive-Thru Window 2
- Reporting Crew Member: Tyler Brooks
- Guest Name: Naomi Ibrahim
- Contact: (555) 014-8832

## Transaction Data
| Item Code | Description | Special Instructions | Price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 104 | Crispy Chicken Sandwich Meal | NO PICKLES, ADD BACON | $11.49 |
| 202 | Medium Waffle Fries | Standard | $2.79 |
| 308 | Large Unsweet Iced Tea | Extra Lemon | $2.49 |
| 412 | Chocolate Milkshake | Standard | $4.29 |

Subtotal: $21.06
Tax (8.25%): $1.74
Total Paid: $22.80
Payment Method: Visa ending in 4109

## Nature of Complaint
Guest returned to the walk-in counter at 1:05 PM stating that order #318 was prepared incorrectly. The sandwich in the bag was a Spicy Deluxe with dill pickles and pepper jack cheese, rather than the ordered Crispy Chicken Sandwich without pickles.

- The guest has a severe gluten allergy and cannot ingest pickles due to brine cross-contamination.
- Crew member Tyler Brooks misread the kitchen screen and handed out order #319 to the vehicle at Window 2.

## Action Taken and Resolution
- Shift supervisor apologized and immediately sent an expedited priority remake for ticket #318 to the kitchen line.
- Remake handed to guest at 1:12 PM, verified personally with no pickles and added bacon.
- Processed a full credit card refund of $22.80 back to the guest's Visa ending in 4109.
- Because the guest already received a full monetary refund, no replacement food was provided to the customer.
- Issued guest a $10.00 digital promotional card (Promo Code: OAK4108) via text message for future visits.
- Conducted a 5-minute huddle with window team regarding order verification procedures before handing bags out.

errors.quote: severe gluten allergy and cannot ingest pickles
errors.explanation: Pickles and pickle brine relate to a cucumber or preservative/food sensitivity, not a gluten allergy, which involves wheat, barley, or rye.
errors.fix: severe pickle allergy and cannot ingest pickles

errors.quote: Because the guest already received a full monetary refund, no replacement food was provided to the customer.
errors.explanation: This directly contradicts the previous bullet points stating that an expedited remake was sent to the kitchen line and handed to the guest at 1:12 PM.
errors.fix: In addition to remaking the order at no charge, a full monetary refund was provided to the customer.
